messages:
marta: Heads-up — during today's 11:40-12:10 UTC peak batching window we saw p95 east-west latency jump from ~2.3ms -> 18-25ms across a subset of racks. Logs / quick summary below.

sam: Oof. Which racks? Any common NIC/firmware? Packet loss seen?

marta: Affected pods on gpu-pool-us-west-2a, racks r12-r14. No application errors, just long tail tokens. Perf metrics: p50 2.5ms p95 22ms p99 45ms. Kernel dmesg on host-g12 shows sporadic mlx5 errors:
```
mlx5_core 0000:3b:00.0: WARNING die: 0x3
mlx5_core 0000:3b:00.0: DMA mapping failed
```

raj: Can you grab `ethtool -S` + ibdev counters and an rdma-core log? Last week we pushed a firmware bump on r12. Might be RDMA fallback causing TCP/UDP pathing.

marta: attaching quick outputs: `ethtool -S bond0` shows drops on rx_packets_lro, `ibdev2netdev` mapping fluctuates. Also saw `rdma: rxe: cqe timeout` in /var/log/messages. Started to correlate with batching ramp at ~11:42.

kai: Also check MTU — I've seen jumbo mismatch trigger fragmentation and latency at scale. Run `ip link show` on both ends, and `tcpdump -n -i bond0 'ip[2:2] > 1500'` to catch fragments.

sam: Ran `iperf3` quick between two affected nodes during a maintenance window and saw occasional 10-20ms spikes with ~0.5% packet loss when we drove small RPC-sized flows. Could be queueing from continuous-batching bursts.

marta: Note: the spike doesn't affect all racks. control-plane and storage flows unaffected. It looks east-west only among GPU hosts in that cohort.

infra-bot: [alert] High e2w-latency detected on cluster:gpu-pool-us-west-2a between 11:41-11:49 UTC. Related incidents: none.

raj: Hypothesis: firmware + jumbo MTU mismatch + RDMA fallback to unreliable path during high concurrent small RPCs from the serving runtime's batching. Action items:
- collect `tcpdump -w /tmp/gpu-e2w-<ts>.pcap` across one good/one bad node
- get `dmesg -T` and `ethtool -S` for both
- pin firmware back on r12 if we can repro in canary

marta: I'll collect pcaps and schedule a canary repro at 0300 UTC. Leaving debug hooks enabled: bpftrace for NIC queueing latencies. Any quick mitigation? Lower batching concurrency or route traffic to another AZ?

kai: Short-term: reduce `max_batch_workers` on the serving runtime for that pool and enable fallback route to dedicated nodes. Also add `tc qdisc fq_codel` to smooth microbursts.

sam: +1 on fq_codel. Also enable per-node `sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_low_latency=1` for experiment.

marta: Thanks. Uploading artifacts to /tmp/gpu-e2w-1768234567.tar.gz and will post update after canary run.

raj: If repro is clean, we'll rollback firmware on r12 and open an RMA with vendor. Keep us posted.

marta: will do. :thumbsup:
